images.name: Separate Hard Lumps
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 1: Small, hard, separate lumps that look like nuts or rabbit droppings.

images.name: Lumpy and Sausage-Shaped
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 2: Sausage-shaped but lumpy on the surface — like several Type 1 lumps pressed together.

images.name: Sausage-Shaped with Cracks
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 3: Like a sausage but with cracks on the surface. Holds together, passes smoothly.

images.name: Smooth and Snake-Like
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 4: Smooth, soft, and snake-like or sausage-shaped. Typically a single piece.

images.name: Soft Blobs with Clear Edges
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 5: Soft blobs with clear-cut edges that pass easily. Multiple separate pieces.

images.name: Mushy with Ragged Edges
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 6: Fluffy pieces with ragged edges, a mushy stool. No definite shape.

images.name: Entirely Liquid
images.alt: Bristol Stool Chart Type 7: Completely liquid with no solid pieces. Watery.
